actor_instance: Codex GPT-6, FBM V1 autonomous MFM replay design
authority: Procedure planning only. The shared MFM is not trained or qualified, no admitted 1.6 corpus or 1.6 codec/trainer/inference/evaluator completion is claimed, and FBM per-user automatic adaptation has not run.
failure_or_lesson: Combining data coverage, source checks, CPU processor tests, GPU fit, model quality and consumer FBM autonomy in one train step would let a partial receipt look like a complete MFM. Keep each dependency and causal outcome explicit. Developer adjudication of the shared model must not become a per-user installation burden. The existing shared-corpus admission requires formation_training plus model_distribution; that condition is inappropriate for private user-local adaptation, which needs its own scoped consent contract and no mandatory two-reviewer workflow.
goal: Make FBM capable of replaying a complete V1 MFM build from rights-qualified shared competence through automatic per-user adaptation while preventing code, CPU, GPU or source receipts from being misreported as product quality.
procedure: Keep source and role-clone custody distinct; design full-role 1.6 targets; authenticate original rights, two independent development target reviews and sealed FINAL; implement matching codec, trainer, inference, evaluator and downstream adapter; obtain exact CPU processor and bounded GPU backward/restart receipts; admit paid fit only after their joint readiness gate; compare trained to matched seeded-untrained outputs; evaluate actual evidence-to-Claim-gate-to-judgment on independent FINAL; then test FBM building isolated per-user state from authorized corpora with cold-start abstention, no user hand-labeled gold and no private gradients in shared weights. For consumer private adaptation, run a distinct owner-scoped admission contract: local formation_training consent permits private weights without model_distribution permission; denied training may still allow separately authorized governed memory/retrieval. Do not apply the shared distributable-source checker unchanged to consumer data.
supersedes_scope: Active V1 replay ordering and future FBM product adaptation gate; prior factual traces and exact public source pins retained
validation: Active seed DAG separates shared corpus admission from private owner admission, keeps the latter tool null, and leaves all unachieved 1.6 tools blocked. Public MFM/foundation pins and historical audit hash remain unchanged; JSON DAG/receipt assertions checked locally before commit.
